notes: *Bezalel* at t037 is correctly `added`: the Hebrew clause writes only עָשָׂה אֹתָם, with no subject nominal (rule 17).

The head of שֵׁשׁ → *fine linen* on *linen* is a genuine tie under rule 31. *linen* alone is any linen, which would head it on *fine* as *dry land* heads on *dry*; but *linen* already names the material, which heads it on *linen* as *sea monsters* heads on *monsters*. Left as accepted, though the note's stated ground (*fine* alone names nothing) is the part-of-speech reasoning rule 31 sets aside; the tannin clause is the defensible ground.
